note: ADR-0011 3.2 first bars; the cabinet is the convolution half of class E (3.5), whose bars are for an amp capture and its cabinet together, so its CPU is reported as a share and not held (Amendment 1). Latency 0 (convolver.h), measured on the unit impulse it is before a response is loaded, because a response has its own group delay. The response rendered equals the loaded one sampled at the session rate: exactly at the response's own rate (float rounding, 3.7e-8 measured), through the Kaiser-sinc resampler at 44.1 and 96 kHz (5e-6 measured, a band-limited test response). A change of response dips the wet path through zero (4 ms out, 128 samples held, 4 ms in) and no sample step exceeds 1.2x the steady sine's (0.98 measured). Measured on an i7-11800H in the sonora-build container, stereo, 0.3 s response, q128 48 kHz: p99.9 133 us, max 151 us per block (per-block minimum of 5 runs), 53 % of class E's 250 us p99.9 before the amp.
